logline: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 2's confrontation at the altar, where Juliana publicly exposed Gerald's dishonor before the entire aristocratic congregation.

dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
dialogue_segments.text: You have humiliated this family enough for one day.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Pained, Betrayed)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I was humiliated by your family.

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Brutal, Dismissive)

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm)

dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
dialogue_segments.text: Your father has chosen his family...

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLE MATRIARCH (Indignant, Screeching)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
dialogue_segments.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!

logline: Fleeing her captivity through a secret passage, Alexander's elderly mother treks through a bitter blizzard to a secluded cabin, where she tearfully reunites with her presumed-dead son and learns the horrifying conspiracy behind his supposed demise.
continuity_notes: While Juliana faces trial and sentencing in the courtroom, this episode reveals Alexander's mother escaping confinement and tracking down Alexander in his mountain hideout, uncovering the dark treason that orchestrates both their fates.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steady, Focused)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grave)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: We were close to finding him.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Hollow)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I was shot. Left for dead.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Somber, Low)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Continuing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER (Aghast, Stunned)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
dialogue_segments.text: Then why did they never tell us?

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Ominous, Deliberate)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Brooding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I spent three years trying to find out.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Fierce, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: The ambush was not an accident.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Vehement, Enraged)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Someone ordered my men to die.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Deadly, Chilling)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.

logline: As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's public execution decree to terrorize the county, Juliana endures starvation in the dungeon, refusing to break her spirit.
continuity_notes: Following Alexander's vow to return in two days to disrupt the wedding, Rupert and Catherine prepare to cement their coup by inviting high society to celebrate their nuptials and witness Juliana's execution.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Chilling, Sharp)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Not just an execution. A warning.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Contemptuous, Scornful)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Smug Triumph)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Weak, Whispering through Tears)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They think hunger will make me surrender.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce Resolve)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They think fear will make me beg.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate Defiance)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They can take my name. They can take my home.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Indomitable Spirit)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: They cannot take who I am!

dialogue_segments.label: NOBLEMAN (Quietly Skeptical)
dialogue_segments.speaker: NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Do you think she'll actually be executed?

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Dismissive, Certain)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: After what she has been accused of? Of course.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Bitter, Cold)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Venomous Monologue)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CLARISSA (Chilling Proclamation)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
dialogue_segments.text: Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place.

logline: The High Priest places the sanctuary under Crown seizure and invalidates Alexander and Juliana's wedding for lack of royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day ecclesiastical trial while Catherine schemes to destroy them.
continuity_notes: Picks up directly from Episode 45's cliffhanger where the High Priest stormed into the church with royal guards and challenged the legality of Alexander and Juliana's marriage.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Thundering)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce, Defiant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Passionate, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Condescending, Venomous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Accusatory, Pained)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Shouting, Triumphant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!

dialogue_segments.label: CATHERINE (Malicious, Taunting)
dialogue_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (O.S. / Low, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Commanding, Severe)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Booming, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Resolute)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Stern, Unflinching)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Defiant, Commanding)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Chilling, Victorious)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Steely, Unfazed)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.

dialogue_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Thunderous, Imposing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
dialogue_segments.text: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!

dialogue_segments.label: HIGH PRIEST (Ominous, Warning)
dialogue_segments.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
dialogue_segments.text: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.

action_segments.label: ACTION
action_segments.text: The guards slowly lower their weapon points away from the Duke.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Certain, Focused)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: This is not simply old age.

dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Serious, Chilled)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: I have seen these symptoms before.

top_evidence_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
top_evidence_segments.text: No.

top_evidence_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
top_evidence_segments.text: What are you saying?

top_evidence_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
top_evidence_segments.text: Someone is poisoning her.

top_evidence_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
top_evidence_segments.text: Poison?

dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Authoritative)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: Girl. Show me what you are holding.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Medicine? You are a new maid.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Incredulous, Accusing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Spiteful, Indignant)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: Then you administered it without permission.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Interrogating)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: The physicians were not saving her!

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Measured, Menacing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: My aunt has been wasting away for months.

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Threatening)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed...

dialogue_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (O.S.) (Contemptuous)
dialogue_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
dialogue_segments.text: ...holding a substance no one authorized her to give.

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Urgent)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: Someone has been poisoning Her Grace.

dialogue_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing)
dialogue_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
dialogue_segments.text: She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!

dialogue_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged)
dialogue_segments.speaker: JULIANA
dialogue_segments.text: That is not what I said!
